excellence.title: Marks of Excellence
excellence.description: Vehicles by the marks on their gun. A mark is a sustained average: the game scores it on a rolling window of recent battles against what the region does on that vehicle.
excellence.partial: Marks read for {known} of {garage} vehicles. The rest fill in as the account is refreshed.
excellence.note-share: {marked} of {garage} vehicles carry a mark ({percent}% of the garage).

mastery.title: Marks of Mastery
mastery.description: Vehicles by their best badge. A badge is one battle rather than an average: the game awards it on a single game’s experience against what the region scores on that vehicle.
mastery.note: {aces} of {garage} vehicles carry an Ace Tanker.
mastery.note-share: {aces} of {garage} vehicles carry an Ace Tanker ({percent}% of the garage).

reach.heading: Playing above the gun
reach.description: Vehicles whose combined damage already clears a mark they do not carry. The badge is that combined damage, coloured by the mark it clears.
